## 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I am frustrated when...")

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe the new behavior or UI design elements.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## 💬 Additional Context
Add any other context, code design mockups, visual examples, or screenshots about the feature request here.
